title: Characterization of Infants' General Movements Using a Commercial RGB-Depth Sensor and a Deep Neural Network Tracking Processing Tool: An Exploratory Study.
summary: A DeepLabCut/RGB-D pipeline generated 3D infant movement metrics in home recordings from eight infants; seven of eight showed patterns the authors judged consistent with expectations relative to two clinicians’ qualitative concern ratings. This is exploratory feasibility evidence, not validated screening or diagnosis. External replication and prospective utility were not established.
